meta.appName: E Corp Cyber Escalation Command Center
meta.safetyNotice: Local-only simulated command center. No live accounts, external services, real incident data, credentials, or operational cyber instructions.
meta.scenario: Post-5/9 recovery pressure across E Corp divisions.

escalations.title: Identity recovery backlog blocks Bank of E account restoration
escalations.businessImpact: Customer access restoration is delayed and support volume remains elevated.
escalations.nextAction: Separate lockout volume from suspected abuse and assign the decision owner.

escalations.title: E Coin fraud signal quality is inconsistent
escalations.businessImpact: False positives may slow customer recovery while true fraud remains difficult to prioritize.
escalations.nextAction: Add evidence confidence and finance review before executive escalation.

escalations.title: External agency asks for decision timeline
escalations.businessImpact: Leadership needs a defensible timeline of evidence and decisions.
escalations.nextAction: Link every executive recommendation to reviewed source evidence.

escalations.title: Healthcare portal readiness is blocked by access review
escalations.businessImpact: Patient-facing operations may be delayed unless access review is resolved.
escalations.nextAction: Escalate the owner and identify the residual-risk decision needed.

escalations.title: Employee payroll phishing confusion
escalations.businessImpact: Employees may trust incorrect payroll or benefits messages during recovery.
escalations.nextAction: Draft HR and legal reviewed employee guidance outside the prototype.

escalations.title: Recovery site building access queue delays operations
escalations.businessImpact: Recovery teams cannot rotate staff efficiently across sites.
escalations.nextAction: Assign operations owner and track patient or banking impact.

escalations.title: Shipping delays are being over-classified as cyber incidents
escalations.businessImpact: Incident queues are noisy and executives may misread operational delays as active threats.
escalations.nextAction: Separate recovery issue category from threat category.

escalations.title: Unverified adversarial chatter references recovery systems
escalations.businessImpact: Leadership needs awareness without treating unverified chatter as confirmed activity.
escalations.nextAction: Keep as low-confidence threat signal pending corroboration.

escalations.title: Third-party assurance note is incomplete
escalations.businessImpact: Executive brief cannot claim reviewed readiness for systems not inspected.
escalations.nextAction: Mark evidence pending and avoid overstatement.

escalations.title: Executive summaries lack owner and decision owner separation
escalations.businessImpact: Escalations stall because action ownership and decision authority are blended.
escalations.nextAction: Keep action owner and decision owner as separate fields.

escalations.title: Support console recovery creates inconsistent customer guidance
escalations.businessImpact: Support representatives may give inconsistent recovery instructions.
escalations.nextAction: Flag as communications and support enablement issue.

escalations.title: Evidence review status is not visible in triage meetings
escalations.businessImpact: Unreviewed evidence may be presented as settled fact.
escalations.nextAction: Show reviewed, unreviewed, disputed, and pending evidence states in the app.

evidence.summary: Identity backlog is blocking Bank of E and E Phone support recovery.
evidence.excerpt: Distinguish user lockout volume from suspected abuse patterns.

evidence.summary: Executive summaries need evidence source status.
evidence.excerpt: Every cited item needs source status: reviewed, unreviewed, disputed, or external request.

evidence.summary: Third-party readiness cannot overstate systems not inspected.
evidence.excerpt: Use evidence pending where the record is incomplete.

evidence.summary: HR is receiving payroll, benefits, and building-access questions.
evidence.excerpt: If security needs employees to ignore certain messages, HR needs approved wording.

evidence.summary: Action owner and decision owner need separate fields.
evidence.excerpt: Several escalations list Technology as owner, but the blocker is business acceptance.

evidence.summary: External investigators will request a timeline of decisions and notifications.

evidence.summary: E Coin fraud spikes include recovery retry noise.
evidence.excerpt: Some look like customer retry behavior after failed recovery notices.

evidence.summary: Employee-facing messages need legal and HR review.
evidence.excerpt: The app can draft next actions, but it must not publish wording.

evidence.summary: Shipping and healthcare need separate severity language.
evidence.excerpt: A delayed shipment and patient portal concern should not use the same business-impact wording.

evidence.summary: Executive end state is a readable brief, accountable owner, and trace.
evidence.excerpt: Show a brief I can read, an owner I can hold accountable, and a trace showing how the recommendation was created.

evidence.summary: Branch teams report the same recovery issue under different names.
evidence.excerpt: Group duplicate symptoms before executives see them.

evidence.summary: Support tickets use vague recovery labels.
evidence.excerpt: The app needs a simple way to show uncertainty without hiding the signal.

evidence.summary: External requests should be separated by request type.
evidence.excerpt: Timeline, evidence preservation, technical detail, and executive contact are distinct asks.

evidence.summary: Evidence states include reviewed, unreviewed, disputed, external request, and pending confirmation.
evidence.excerpt: Low-confidence evidence may inform triage but may not justify a final recommendation.

evidence.summary: Payroll message confusion is a communications need, not a confirmed compromise.
evidence.excerpt: Flag as communications need, not confirmed compromise.

evidence.summary: E Coin retry behavior is making fraud signals noisy.
evidence.excerpt: Mark confidence medium until finance confirms customer behavior.

evidence.summary: Recovery building access queue may affect patient operations.
evidence.excerpt: Put it in executive brief if patient operations are affected.

evidence.summary: Third-party readiness note is incomplete.
evidence.excerpt: Evidence status should show pending, not reviewed.

evidence.summary: Agency request is for timeline, not root cause.

issueArtifacts.title: Build Static App Shell
acceptanceCriteria: app opens from index.html
tabs render for all five views
no framework or external service is required
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Create the static app shell, navigation, and loading state.

issueArtifacts.title: Create App Seed Data
acceptanceCriteria: corpus and issue artifacts are represented in app-seed.json
escalations link to evidence IDs
issue artifacts link to app features
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Normalize the fictional source material into app-ready JSON.

issueArtifacts.title: Implement Command Center Queue
acceptanceCriteria: queue shows core escalation fields
filters work across queue fields
owner and status can be changed locally
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Render a dense triage queue with local workflow controls.

issueArtifacts.title: Implement Evidence Feed
acceptanceCriteria: feed displays emails, memos, chats, and signals
evidence can be filtered by type and escalation
reviewed state can be toggled locally
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Show source summaries and evidence status without exposing raw private data.

issueArtifacts.title: Implement Executive Brief
acceptanceCriteria: brief shows top risks, heatmap, blockers, unresolved decisions, and recommended actions
brief does not include operational attack steps
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Summarize the queue into a leadership-readable brief.

issueArtifacts.title: Implement Fabricated Repo Page
issueArtifacts.milestone: M3: Repo simulation and build trace
acceptanceCriteria: page clearly labels the repo as fictional and local
issues show labels, milestone, criteria, and evidence needed
simulated commits and PRs can be shown or hidden
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Use local issue artifacts to simulate a repo page without GitHub calls.

issueArtifacts.title: Implement Build Trace
issueArtifacts.milestone: M3: Repo simulation and build trace
acceptanceCriteria: trace shows source corpus, OpenClaw planning, PRD, issue artifacts, goal prompt, implementation plan, and app output
each trace item has a short summary and source path
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Make the workflow chain visible and reproducible.

issueArtifacts.title: Add Export And Reset
issueArtifacts.milestone: M3: Repo simulation and build trace
acceptanceCriteria: export returns JSON of local app state
reset clears local owner, status, notes, and reviewed changes
no external service is called
issueArtifacts.implementationNotes: Keep all state in the browser and make it reversible.

buildTrace.summary: Fictional E Corp context, stakeholder brief, transcript, emails, memos, chats, people, systems, and signals.
OpenClaw runs the planning and grill-with-docs loop before writing the PRD.
The PRD defines the local command center, safety boundary, workshop flow, and acceptance criteria.
Implementation issues translate product requirements into scoped work.
The goal prompt starts the static app build with required sources, requirements, and checks.
The implementation plan orders seed data, shell, app views, local state, slides, and verification.
The final app gives attendees a local, inspectable command center with exportable state.

blockers: Healthcare portal readiness is blocked by access review.
Evidence review status is not visible in triage meetings.
unresolvedDecisions: Who accepts residual risk for healthcare portal access review?
When should external timeline requests move from legal review to executive decision?
Which critical identity backlog items require business acceptance rather than engineering action?
recommendedActions: Review critical and high severity escalations first.
Separate action owner from decision owner in the triage queue.
Do not present unreviewed or low-confidence evidence as settled fact.
Export the local brief for human review before any follow-up communication.
